content: Isari munon Parisi ne Sadyusi yar Yisas wariges qebi qomurune Qenu wonou qomon wes eng aba gub qamb qebi qamamirei.
Qamarari Yisas taui wurinob qamar: “Worom uber is neri mian arirama gab, “qo qen mom uber” ende qamb igoumon.

Ne itumut worom diab ai quruburima mian bura gab, “qo ya deriba” ende qamb igoumon. Git apand ai end aba gab qeemben qerei igoumon. Ego qen see eng qen boru irou dibent isub igo ego an musub me imbigoumon.

An munon yamangar boru misir ue see igoumon eng, ye mi wes ebine gub qamb quraumon. Ego ye mi wes ger me ebinei, qomon wes ger abau eng uput qamb qoan Yona ebeter eng igar.” Ende qamb wogub wuriwogub qorei.
16:5-12 Yisas mit big qob qamb Parisi Sadyusi nob wurit qamarei
Qen end Yisas wonou imbigau yurau eng ya tai eng wogub ig iro isumirei. Qen end wuri mani qibi baioun qamb nasi wogub isumirei.
Ende gab Yisas der wurinob qamar: “An Parisi Sadyusi nob wurinou yis end qoyamet igoarar.”
Ende qamara wuri der wurinou qob-qob qamamir: “Mai, in mani qibi nasi wogub yoroun end mai qura qiyo?”
Ende qamb abari Yisas wuriimbig ne wurinob qamar: “An meimet qamb mani qibi me ba yarau end misir qebebi igub qobub igoumon? Aninou oau apand eng aib ue qiyo?
An mi eng nasi wogomanei qiyo? Qoan mani parau 5-ende boroumi munon yurau 5,000-end wurisune nub tatau wagari usis tugar mai-mai tugarimari diarei?
Ne gor, mani parau 7-ende eng munon yurau 4,000-ende wurisune nub tatau wagari tugar mai-mai tugarimari diarei.
End ne ye meimet qamb mani qibi baiar qamb me aninob qamarau? An Parisi Sadyusi nob wurinou yis boru end qoyamet igoarar.”
Ende qamara wuri mom imbig ne qamamir: “Qo, wo eng at qurar eng yis mani paraut big iset igour end me qura, ue. Wo Parisi Sadyusi wurinou qob boru end qura,” ende qamamirei.
16:13-20 Pita Yisas qanam ba dibes qamarei
Ende at wogub ne bo ai Sisaria Pilipai nob end isub Yisas der wonou imbigau yurau eng wuri qebi qamar: “Munon yamangar Munangit Wau eng wot mai qamarari igub igoumon?”
Ne wuri qamamir: “Qei nenet, Yon munon yat wurimaragansi igoar eng. Ne qei nenet, Elaiya, ne qei nenet, Yeremaia, ne qei nenet munon miteri qamb igo ger, ende nenet qamb igour.”
Ende qamarari wurinou sir wuriqebi qamar: “Ende eng an yet your qamb igoumon?”
Ende qamara Saimon Pita der taui qamar: “Ne Munon inubersiau tari, Qenu qenen igomot igo eng wonou Wau ten.”

Ende qamara Yisas taui qamar: “Ne Yon wonou wau, sig uber qeemben ar quran. Ne oau apand eng igama quran eng munangit ger nonob qamarari igub me quran, ue. Yonou Tain wonou ginamt igo eng oau nemenima quran.
End ne ye ete nonob quraum: Ne unum eng Pita, qanam eng nomon. Nomon eng erer end yonou munon yurau eng nenet erer end wuribigine naget nonoguretorubour. Ende igo bo sabar me umunorei.
Qenu wonou ginamt bibis big igo tend eng nenet wugine qoat igoriban. End ne ne mi ag et tourieminen eng Qenu wonou ginamt end tourimba. a ag et beasieminen eng Qenu wonou ginamt end gor beasimba.”
Ende qamb wogub wonou imbigau yurau eng at munon inubersiau tari eng dibes qomorunor qamb qoronob wuritaisiarei.
16:21-28 Yisas waramari uminer end qamarei

Qen end gari wonou uminer end wonou imbigau yurau eng musub wurinob qamar: “Ye Yerusalem qumo isine munon baraitari eng ne Pris wurinou gigit eng ne qomon qerei imbig igour eng der yanamari umine yetumunimunorei igama qen ombur gari uma bo igomot der bugembam.”
Ende qamara Pita der Yisas nob wes opur ete isub qamat qamar: “Barai, Qenu ne mom nequbei igo end bais ende me nesiorunorei.”
Ende qamara Yisas igeser Pita nob qamar: “Satan, qand yewogub iua, ye werei opurama wog. Ne misir eng igub quran eng Qenu wonou misir ue, misir eng munangit wurinou.”
Ende qamb imbigau yurau gugum wurinob qamar: “An ger ye yenob qib igorib eng wonomit misir me iginer, wonomi qugurau eng togor ye toat yariner.
Your ger see igom igamau end misir qebebi igub eng mom umiba. A yet igub wonou git goan eng duieminer eng igomot igoriba.

Munon ger wonou git goan musiau end qas misir igub mind irou ba qiumuni big igoriner eng isi yarab uma eng, mind eng der maigas at musieriba? Wonou igomot igorib qamb meimi eng ba taui igomot igoriba? Sig ue ar.
Munangit wau wonou Ur qenenginob eng wot isub waga ten deriba, dara wonou enger eng nob dorubour. Qen end munon wurinou qomon ebet igorunor eng taui qamb ende wurisieriba.
Mi eng apand aninob quraum, munon qei see igorunor eng qei me umunorei igo Munangit Wau munon baraitari burab dara gubour.”
